import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import App, { parseFlyMailHomeCommand } from '@src/response-apps/flyMail/home/app';
import { sendFifthLayerLockedPage } from '@src/response/access/fifthLayer';
import { sendSecondLayerLockedPage } from '@src/response/access/secondLayer';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui, type GuiButton } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

const SCOPE_LABEL = {
  friend: '好友飞信',
  master: '师门飞信',
  guild: '宗门飞信',
  companion: '道侣飞信',
  team: '队伍飞信'
} as const;

const SCOPE_NAV_COMMAND = {
  friend: '/飞信 {page}',
  master: '/飞信 师门 {page}',
  guild: '/飞信 宗门 {page}',
  companion: '/飞信 道侣 {page}',
  team: '/飞信 队伍 {page}'
} as const;

const buildUsageLines = (scope: keyof typeof SCOPE_LABEL): string[] => {
  if (scope === 'friend') {
    return ['发送：/发飞信 <好友UID|@目标> <内容>', '禁言：/飞信禁言 <UID|@目标>', '解除：/飞信解除 <UID|@目标>'];
  }
  if (scope === 'master') {
    return ['发送：/发师门飞信 <内容>'];
  }
  if (scope === 'guild') {
    return ['发送：/发宗门飞信 <内容>'];
  }
  if (scope === 'team') {
    return ['发送：/发队伍飞信 <内容>'];
  }

  return ['发送：/发道侣飞信 <内容>'];
};

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const uid = Number(e.uid);
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const parsed = parseFlyMailHomeCommand(e.MessageText);

  if (!parsed) {
    return;
  }

  let result: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof App>>;

  try {
    result = await App({ bid, uid, scope: parsed.scope, page: parsed.page });
  } catch {
    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '飞信', content: Format.createMarkdown().addText('飞信暂不可用') }));

    return;
  }
  if (!result.data.access.allowed) {
    const render = parsed.scope === 'team' ? sendSecondLayerLockedPage : sendFifthLayerLockedPage;

    render({ bid, isPrivate, message, title: '飞信', realmName: result.data.access.realmName });

    return;
  }

  const label = SCOPE_LABEL[parsed.scope];
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`当前频道：${label}`));
  const usageMd = Format.createMarkdown();

  buildUsageLines(parsed.scope).forEach((line, index) => {
    if (index > 0) {
      usageMd.addNewline();
    }
    usageMd.addText(line);
  });
  md.addBlockquote(usageMd);

  if (parsed.scope === 'friend') {
    const muteText = result.data.muteList.length > 0 ? result.data.muteList.map(item => `${item.name}(${item.uid})`).join('、') : '无';

    md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`已禁言：${muteText}`));
  }

  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(result.data.total > 0 ? '最近飞信' : '最近飞信：暂无');
  md.addNewline();

  result.data.list.forEach(item => {
    md.addText(`【${item.senderName}(${item.senderUid})】`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addBlockquote(
      Format.createMarkdown()
        .addText(`${item.createdAt.toLocaleString('zh-CN', { hour12: false })}`)
        .addNewline()
        .addText(`${item.content}`)
    );
  });

  const footer: GuiButton[][] = [
    [
      { label: '好友', command: '/飞信' },
      { label: '师门', command: '/飞信 师门' },
      { label: '宗门', command: '/飞信 宗门' },
      { label: '道侣', command: '/飞信 道侣' },
      { label: '队伍', command: '/飞信 队伍' }
    ]
  ];

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '飞信',
      content: md,
      footer,
      nav:
        result.data.totalPage > 1
          ? {
              current: result.data.page,
              total: result.data.totalPage,
              count: result.data.total,
              command: SCOPE_NAV_COMMAND[parsed.scope]
            }
          : undefined
    })
  );
});
